messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Canary cluster 'eu-west-1-canary' reporting elevated 500s on /orders API and DB errors in logs. Paging oncall-sre.

oncall-sre (maria): I'm on it. grabbing logs and will triage.

raj (eng-runtime): saw a spike in 502/500 traces pointing to DB migration runner errors during canary deploy. stack shows: `ERROR: relation \"orders.payment_method\" does not exist`.

maria: that's consistent with a schema change that didn't finish on canary nodes. canary deploy was pushing v3.4.0 which includes `add_column payment_method`.

lina (support): getting multiple customer reports: ticket #C-18934, #C-18936 — users see checkout failures. severity P1 by volume.

jess (product): how many users are impacted? is this limited to canary traffic?

raj: should be limited to canary, but LB routing sent ~3% of live traffic to canaries — that still hits production customers.

maria: grabbing DB process list now. run: ```sql
SELECT pid, usename, application_name, state, query_start, wait_event_type, query
FROM pg_stat_activity
WHERE state <> 'idle' ORDER BY query_start DESC;
```

maria: found a long-running migration txn: pid=84211, started 12m ago, holding exclusive lock on `orders` while running ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN (retry safe?). This is blocking other schema ops.

sanjay (dba): that tx is blocking our online migrations. I suspect the migration script hit a slow index rebuild on big table. Killing it will abort the migration but leave schema in pre-migration state.

raj: options: 1) terminate the tx and rollback migration; 2) try to complete migration on canary (risky); 3) flip feature flag to disable new code path so missing column isn't referenced.

jess: product preference: minimize customer impact ASAP. Flip flag if possible, then abort migration and pause rollout.

maria: agreed. Can we flip feature flag remotely? which flag?

raj: flag is `feature/orders-new-payment-flow`. We can flip via admin console or API: `POST https://cfg.redwood.internal/flags/orders-new-payment-flow` body `{ "enabled": false }`. I'll flip now.

raj: (to deploy-bot) `@deploy-bot disable-flag orders-new-payment-flow --reason "canary migration failure"`

deploy-bot: Confirmed: flag `orders-new-payment-flow` set to false for eu-west-1. Changes propagated to 3/3 canary instances.

maria: rolling errors dropped immediately in app logs referencing missing column. Good sign. Customer error rate down ~85%. still seeing some 500s from partial requests.

lina: support: informing impacted customers we are rolling back canary code and disabling feature. providing ETA 30m.

sanjay (dba): ready to terminate the blocking backend. Will run `SELECT pg_terminate_backend(84211);` — this will roll back the migration transaction so schema remains as before. We should ensure no other migrations are mid-flight.

raj: checklist: a) disable flag (done), b) terminate tx (pending), c) pause canary rollout / stop deployment (do not proceed to prod), d) rollback canary release if needed.

maria: pausing rollout now. `deploy-bot pause-rollout canary eu-west-1 v3.4.0`

deploy-bot: Rollout paused. No further canary promotions.

sanjay (dba): executing terminate: ```sql
-- terminate blocking migration tx
SELECT pg_terminate_backend(84211);
```

sanjay (dba): done. backend terminated; migration rolled back. verify: `SELECT to_regclass('orders.payment_method')` returns NULL.

raj: good. app now stops referencing the column due to flag off. I see error count back to baseline for /orders.

jess (product): can we resume normal traffic routing for unaffected endpoints? we should keep canary traffic at 0% until we validate a safe migration path.

maria: setting canary routing to 0%: `infra-bot set-weight eu-west-1-canary 0`

infra-bot: Canary weight set to 0%.

lina: updating customers: posting status that we've mitigated impact by disabling feature and aborting migration; tickets updated.

maria: handing off to next oncall for postmortem and followup DB work. @oncall-sre (next) please take. I'll be offline in 10m but available in threads.

raj: immediate action items recorded: 1) investigate why migration tried exclusive lock on live table — need chunked/online migration; 2) add stronger preflight check in deploy pipeline to detect long-running DDL; 3) create a kill-switch playbook for migrations.

sanjay (dba): follow-up: schedule maintenance window to run migration in controlled window with index rebuilds offloaded; will own the run.

deploy-bot: Incident auto-update: status -> mitigated. Incident channel: https://ops.redwood/internal/incidents/1767845123

incident-bot: Incident Severity: P1 -> Mitigated. Root cause: long-running migration started during canary rollout causing missing schema for canary-coded path. Action taken: feature flag disabled, blocking tx terminated, rollout paused, customers notified. Postmortem owner: raj (eng-runtime).

jess (product): thanks everyone. postmortem timeline + RCA requested within 48h. :thumbsup:

oncall-sre (maria): handing off: `oncall -> raj` at ts=1767845799.

raj (eng-runtime): taking handoff. I'll coordinate the postmortem and the migration remediation plan.

lina (support): closing customer-facing notes.

incident-bot: This thread will remain open until postmortem posted.
